in_marathi.name: Vikramjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory through Power
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikramjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vikramjeet means 'victory through power'. This name is a perfect choice for parents who desire a strong and victorious child. The name Vikramjeet is rooted in Hindu mythology and is a combination of two words - 'Vikram' which means power and 'jeet' which means victory.
